verdict.rationale: Retell documents per-agent data retention periods: call and chat data, including transcripts, recordings, and logs, is automatically and permanently deleted when the period expires. That covers configurable retention well. The deletion side is only documented as time-based auto-expiry, with no evidence of user-initiated, on-demand deletion of specific records. missing for 10: on-demand/manual deletion of individual calls or chats (via API or dashboard), account- or workspace-level deletion controls, details on which retention periods can be set, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Retell allows you to configure a data retention period per agent. After the retention period expires, call and chat data associated with that agent is automatically and permanently deleted.
Configure per-agent data retention to automatically delete call and chat data — transcripts, recordings, and logs — after a set period for compliance.
